graph.name: Kinaï (as heard in transcript): Medical Image Labeling and Per-Project Model Training on EKS and SageMaker
graph.notes: Healthcare company building technology for research and clinical studies, guiding pathologists and doctors in analyzing medical images. Hospitals, biologists and clients upload images to S3 (about 5 TB per project). A Kubernetes (EKS) product acts as the labeling platform for pathologists. Enriched data trains one model per project on SageMaker with FSx (I/O performance) and IAM (security). Models are stored in S3 and exported with results back to the Kubernetes product for validation by the pathologist; validated models are frozen and moved to inference, also on Kubernetes, and used by hospitals. Benefits: scientists work on multiple projects at once, switch projects in seconds and run thousands of trainings in parallel; training is more than 30 times faster; infrastructure cost is reduced by up to 30% (dynamic infrastructure, no payment for unused resources). Compliance: HDS certification, data kept in-region (e.g. German project data stays in Germany).

nodes.name: Hospitals / Biologists / Clients
nodes.notes: Hospitals, biologists and clients send medical images. Hospitals also use the validated model at the end.

nodes.name: Pathologist
nodes.notes: Enriches the data by annotating and labeling the medical images. Validates or refuses the trained model.

nodes.name: Kubernetes Product (Labeling Platform)
nodes.notes: Product running on Kubernetes that serves as the labeling platform for pathologists. Displays images, model and results. Inference for validated (frozen) models also runs on Kubernetes.

nodes.name: S3 Buckets
nodes.notes: Stores incoming medical images (about 5 TB of data per project) and the trained models. Data stays in the project's region (e.g. Germany for a German project).

nodes.name: SageMaker Training
nodes.notes: Trains one model per project on the enriched data. Reuses the same Docker containers as the previous static infrastructure, which made migration easy. Thousands of trainings in parallel, training more than 30 times faster, infrastructure cost savings of up to 30%.

nodes.name: FSx
nodes.notes: Used with SageMaker training for I/O performance.

nodes.name: IAM
nodes.notes: Security and fine-grained control over data access; helps document and comply with certifications such as HDS.
